purpose: Region-defining combat support items, achievement passives, Archaeology combat relic chains, and cross-region equipment dependencies for Equilibrium planning.

policy.region_rule: required_regions means every listed region contributes a mandatory base-game acquisition step. region_hints means the chain touches those regions but may have alternatives or unresolved League overrides.
policy.league_rule: Quest auto-completion and League passives are overlays. Do not erase the underlying item, activity, or geography dependency until Jagex explicitly replaces it.
policy.combat_method_rule: Support items are surfaced when they materially change a listed combat method. They are not treated as mandatory unless the method actually requires them.

equipment_additions.name: Salve amulet (e)
quest_dependencies: Haunted Mine for the base salve amulet
Lair of Tarn Razorlor for Tarn's diary and the enchantment
effects: Stacks with the full Slayer helmet, Void Knight equipment, the Undead Slayer perk, and the Undead Slayer ability
The bonus is on-hit and does not increase damage-over-time abilities or conjures
equipment_additions.notes: This is one of Morytania's strongest cross-region combat support unlocks because it materially improves undead methods outside Morytania, including Lumbridge Catacombs skeletons, bound skeletons, armoured phantoms, and armoured zombies.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Keep Morytania as the normal self-sufficient acquisition region unless Equilibrium explicitly grants the amulet or quest rewards globally.

equipment_additions.name: Amulet of the forsaken to Berserker's Fury
equipment_additions.category: combat necklace and Archaeology relic ingredient
requirements: Saradominist I collection progression for the Lock of hair
Amulet of the forsaken from Barrows
unlocks: Amulet of the forsaken as a Barrows reward
Dharok's Memento by combining the amulet with the Lock of hair
effects: Berserker's Fury deals up to 5.5% more damage as current life points fall below maximum
Does not stack with Dharok's set effect
equipment_additions.notes: Both the Barrows amulet and the Saradominist I/Everlight side of the relic chain are Morytania content, making this a real single-region combat relic unlock rather than a generic Archaeology passive.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Quest auto-completion can satisfy quest gates, but it should not silently remove the Barrows item dependency unless Equilibrium says the relic itself is granted.

equipment_additions.name: Igneous cape progression
requirements: Karamja: Fire cape for the one-time Fight Kiln entry payment
Karamja: Fight Kiln completion for a TokHaar-Kal cape
Misthalin working Senntisten mapping: defeat TzKal-Zuk without checkpoints for an igneous stone
unlocks: Igneous Kal-Zuk after the hard-mode flawless requirement and all four style capes
equipment_additions.notes: The Zuk encounter supplies the igneous stone, but the stone upgrades a TokHaar-Kal cape from Karamja's Fight Kiln. A planner that shows only Misthalin materially understates the cape chain.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Display this as Karamja + Misthalin under the current Senntisten working map. If Equilibrium later assigns Senntisten differently, update only that side of the chain.

activity_additions.name: Berserker's Fury relic chain
effects: Up to 5.5% increased damage at lower current life points
activity_additions.notes: Dharok's Memento requires the Barrows Amulet of the forsaken plus the Saradominist I Lock of hair, so the important necklace dependency is visible instead of being hidden behind the relic name.

activity_additions.name: Heightened Senses relic chain
requirements: Kantharos cup used with the Everlight beam

activity_additions.name: Death Ward relic chain
requirements: Kandarin: restore the Aviansie dreamcoat from Stormguard Citadel
Asgarnia: give the restored artefact to Armadyl at Armadyl's Tower
activity_additions.league_treatment: Keep both regions visible unless Equilibrium auto-completion explicitly bypasses the Armadyl turn-in or supplies the relic directly.

activity_additions.name: Vyre combat and Sunspear progression
unlocks: Up to +100 Sunspear/blisterwood damage from the 500-corpse cremation progression
Automatic Prayer and Firemaking XP from Sunspear cremations
Morytania elite achievement bonus to vyre cremation Prayer and Firemaking XP
activity_additions.notes: Vyrewatch are not a Salve-amulet method. Their important progression is the Ivandis/blisterwood/Sunspear system plus corpse-cremation bonuses.

account_additions.notes: The tier-3 stand grants the effects of the placed Slayer helmet without wearing it, but not the helmet's stats or teleports.

account_additions.notes: The April 2026 Aura Overhaul moved the former Might of Het effect here and removed the old weekly totem charging upkeep.
